title: The Kingdom Principles of Keys Part 1
paragraphs: This is a series that will continue until 2006, so you'd better get used to the kingdom. We will discuss understanding the three most important components in God's complete plan for man. The three most important ingredients you need to know are the king. We should know about the king. We need to know about the kingdom. We must know about the keys to the kingdom. This morning I want to address a topic that focuses on the Kingdom's principle of keys. The Kingdom's principle of keys. This is the second session.

Last week we presented the series. Today we will begin to focus on the Kingdom. We will talk about the principle of keys in the Kingdom of God. Let us, as a subheading, focus on understanding the kingdom and the keys that make it work. Understanding the kingdom and the keys that make it work. First, let's talk a little about rediscovering the good news. Jesus came to Earth with only one message. One message. He did not preach about healing. He did not preach about liberation.

His message was not actually about miracles. He did not preach about religion. He did not preach about being born again. That was not his message. His message was a simple one. Today I will show you some references from your Holy Book to that message which he himself proclaimed. First and foremost, I want you to write down these principles. Number one, the purpose of creating man was to manage a kingdom. This is what God created man for. Man was not created to make a religion or even to be in a religion.

Man was created to manage a kingdom. Principle number two, the fall of man was the loss of a kingdom. When Adam fell, he did not lose heaven. Heaven was never given. He lost a kingdom. The third principle of the codification: The purpose of the redemption was to restore a kingdom. If God sent his Messiah to restore something, it must be what we have lost. So you can see what Adam lost that Jesus came to restore. Solutions always provide indications of the nature of the problem. That's a contradiction.

You can determine the nature of the problem by examining the solution. Therefore, whatever Jesus came to earth to offer as a solution, it must have been the problem. So Adam did not return to heaven. A kingdom has been restored to Adam. The fourth principle, fulfilling God's will, is to re- establish His kingdom on earth. God's will shall be done when His kingdom is established on earth. This is God's plan. After the fall of Adam, God had one goal: to re-establish His heavenly kingdom on Earth.

The final principle I want you to note down is that the program of salvation was the restoration of man to the government of the Kingdom of God. Please write the two words together to restore man to the government of the Kingdom of God. Therefore, whatever God brought to Earth, it had to be a government because that is what man lost. Today I have come to the conclusion that the greatest news in the world is the news that Jesus brought to Earth. Incidentally, the Greek word for "good news" is "evangelio".

This word in the Greek New Testament is the word we translate as "the Gospel". Good news. Why is the promise of a government considered good news? The answer is because there is no functioning government on Earth at the moment. There isn't one. The Chinese cannot stop SARS. The Afghan government remains unstable and its soldiers are killed every day. They tried to fix Iraq, but now American soldiers are being killed daily at checkpoints and there is still a lack of order in the country.

America, which supposedly has the best government in the world, has the highest crime rate in the world. Marriages are dissolved more often in America than in any other country in the world. The divorce rate is one to one. For every two people who get married, one gets divorced. More children are killed in America than are born in the Caribbean each year. Five hundred thousand are killed in the womb. That is the greatest government of all time. The murder capital of America is Washington, D. C.

The capital of the greatest country in the world has the highest murder and felony crime rate in the entire country. In other words, is that government functioning? Then we move to Africa and become depressed. Which government in Africa is functioning? Thousands of people are being killed by their own governments in African countries. Their people are being subjected to genocide at the hands of governments that claim to be working for the people.

And we go to China, the largest country in the world, with more than a billion people, where 80% of the people live in poverty. They claim that communism aims for fair distribution. However, only the rich enjoy the benefits of the communist state. Where can we find a successful government? That is why Jesus brought a government. Secondly, I am glad that he did not come with a debt. There is no successful religion. The number one problem in the world today is a religious problem.

Terrorists use their religion to justify their actions. Islam is determined to destroy every infidel, and this means that anyone who is not a Muslim is an infidel. If you are an infidel, they will either tolerate you, enslave you, or destroy you. That is their religious belief. Hinduism has more than 600 million gods. Which one do you serve? What a confusing religion. Buddhism has great sayings that are useless. Baha'is believe that everyone is right. So wherever you go, you will arrive at the same place.

How can you live like this? Any road will take you there. Scientologists place their faith in science, which simply discovers what God has already made. Which religion will succeed? Even Christianity doesn't succeed. It's a religion. Christianity has killed more people in the name of God than any other religion. Most of the people I know in Christianity are depressed, frustrated, sad, and broke. If religion is the solution, we still have some questions.

It is important to understand the solution that Jesus brought, because if you understand the solution, you will understand what the problem is. He did not bring any religion. Rather, he brought a kingdom. Please write this down. What is the kingdom? He presents his ministry in the Gospel of Matthew, chapter four. Please open to this text. This is a verse that I personally keep reading over and over again because it is the most important statement made by Jesus. Matthew 4:17.

I hope it becomes as much a part of your mind as it is a part of mine. As one thinks, so one is. All I think about now is the kingdom. My friends, it works in my personal life. Matthew 4:17. Let me read it to you. Verse 17, from the NIV version. From that time Jesus began to preach. Quote: "Repent, comma, for the kingdom of heaven has come near." Some translations say: "It is near." In other words, his first public proclamation was the coming of a kingdom, not a religion.

From that moment on, you read all the other chapters up to the twenty-eighth chapter of Matthew, and every page is filled with one word. He kept repeating: The kingdom of God is like. The kingdom of God is like, the kingdom of God is like. He brought a kingdom to the earth. What is the Kingdom? First and foremost, the Kingdom is not a religion. So, what does the kingdom consist of?

I want to reiterate that we, who were born in the Western world and perhaps some parts of South America, do not have a true concept of the Kingdom because we grew up in a democratic and republican environment. Republics and democracies are not monarchies. It does not possess the qualities or characteristics of the Kingdom. Although some parts of the Republic may resemble parts of the Kingdom, in reality it is the complete opposite of kingdoms. That is why it is important to know what the Kingdom is.

The Kingdom is not a parliamentary democracy. In the Bahamas, we do not have a kingdom. Therefore, if you read the Bible through your own experience, you will come to the wrong conclusion. If you approach the Bible from a Republican or Democratic perspective, you will feel confused. First and foremost, the most important thing in the kingdom is the king. In a democracy, we have a prime minister, a president, or a dictator. But in a democracy, there is no king. The king is the sovereign.

The second thing the kingdom possesses is territory. Every kingdom must have a territory. This region is called the domain. You cannot be king over nothing. There must be a place that controls it. Third, every kingdom must have citizens. Citizens in the Kingdom are called subjects. Let everyone say "subjects". There is a reason why they are called subjects. The word "flock" is important and should be adopted by you and me who claim to be in the Kingdom of God. The word "flock" means to be at a lower level.

The word "under" (Sub) means lower. The word "subject" means that the citizens of the kingdom are completely subject to the king. They remain subject to one important reason. Through this series we will learn why it is important to remain under the authority of the king. The fourth thing that the kingdom possesses is the constitution. Every kingdom has a constitution. What is a constitution? The constitution is a covenant between the king and his subjects.

And I want to emphasize that this constitution is not written by the subjects. Rather, the king writes it. The king is the one who determines the covenant or constitution under which people live. In a democracy, the people write the constitution. In the kingdom, the king is the one who writes it. In a democracy, laws are made by the people. In any kingdom, the king makes the law. In fact, the king's word becomes law. Quite the opposite. The fifth thing that the kingdom consists of is the laws.

These laws are called the principles by which the kingdom operates. Every kingdom operates and performs its functions in accordance with the laws. Now, democracies and republics also operate according to laws, except that those laws are formulated by the people through a constitutional process under which they agree to live. In the Kingdom, that is not the case. In the kingdom, the king's words become law. Therefore, people do not make the law in the kingdom. But the king is the one who does that.

Sixth, the kingdom has a government. A very important word: government. Write the word " government" carefully. She possesses governing power. Let me give you another word for government in your holy book. Please write this word. It is the word "cosmos" (K O S). (M O S). Say it to me. Say it out loud for the camera crew to see. A little louder. once again. Shout it so loudly the ceiling shakes. amazing. Say it again. Say it two more times. Say it again.

Now, when your shepherd asks you to say something many times, it means that it is important and that you do not know what it means. The word "cosmos" is found throughout your Bible, in the New Testament, and was used by Jesus, Paul, Peter, James, and every New Testament writer. The word "cosmos" is the Greek word that translates to, write this word, "world". world. And I'm telling you this for a reason. Because when you think of the word government, you are not thinking of that word.

The word government is the same as the word "cosmos". "Cosmos" is the word in your Bible that means " world". The word "world" here means "system of power". Write it down. The system of power. Do you remember Paul? I will give you one example where it was used. Paul says in chapter twelve of his letter to the church in Rome, in verse two: “Do not conform to the pattern of this world.” Stop reading now. I want you to think about the meaning there. Paul used the word "cosmos".

When Paul says, “Do not conform to the pattern of this world,” he is not talking about going to a nightclub. He doesn't talk about drinking alcohol or smoking cigarettes, all those things you're thinking about. No, he used the word "cosmos". Do not resemble this "cosmos ". Rather, change your appearance by renewing your minds, your way of thinking. Why is the word "cosmos" used here? What does the word "cosmos" mean? the world. The word "cosmos" means ruling power, and system of government.

In other words, he is telling us not to be subject to the other government. It's a different concept. Why? Because we are fighting against kingdoms. It is one kingdom against another. Paul says: You were in this ancient kingdom. This ancient kingdom taught you how to think, how to act, trained you, and how to respond, and how one thinks about oneself. So we see, he says that you were in "Cosmos". Now I want you to think about this.

He said that you were living in " Cosmos," that is, under effective government control. Do you think that Satan is just a small devil with horns and a thorn? Let me tell you who the devil is. The devil is an unemployed carob who pretends to be a king. He founded a kingdom. It is called the Kingdom of Darkness. He literally has a government. He controls every human being who comes into the world. His first wish is to bring them under his control. Which means he has a management team. He has a cabinet. Hello.

Oh, listen to me. Look, the Apostle Paul was clever. He understood the whole thing. Paul says, "You are not wrestling with flesh and blood." But first, what are you fighting? Presidents. And where are the evil spirits? In heavenly matters, he says: " And authorities in heavenly matters." You are fighting an entire government machine. Therefore, you cannot confront the devil with your weak prayers. It must be backed by a government. Amen.

You don't simply stand in front of the devil and say to him, "Get out, get out." It is better to have a whole army behind you supporting you. Full governmental authority supports you. That is why Jesus said, when you go to him, do not use your name. Oh, I got ahead of myself. Every time I stand in front of the immigration booth in any country, do you know what they ask for? Passport. They are not looking for me. Oh, you don't understand. When they ask for your passport, they are not looking for you.

They don't care about you as an individual. They are looking for the authority that represents them. Lord, have mercy. If you don't have a passport, they will send you back to where you came from. You are here in person, and you have money with you. You can pay and bring things to their country and benefit them. But they don't want you. They want to know what authority she represents. So they send you back if you're not ready. What are they looking for? About the government.

That's why your passport never truly belongs to you. Your passport states that it belongs to the government of the Bahamas. And perhaps for the United States government. Why? Because this booklet, this seemingly simple thing, is an entire government that supports you. If you are imprisoned, the first thing they will take from you is your passport. Why? They take away your government's support because you are no longer eligible to live in that government's society.

The hardest thing you can get back is your passport because a passport is a kingdom you hold in your hands. You come in the name of your government. Therefore, government is important. Now I want you to think about this from now on. Whenever you see the word "world" in your Bible, stop looking at it as a planet. That word refers to a complete system of government. Pay attention to this. You are in the world, but you are not of it. He is not talking about planet Earth. He's talking about who controls your life.

Which government are you under? You live on the planet, but you are not controlled by the planet's government. You are ruled by an invisible government from the sky. Can I hear "Amen"? The next thing the kingdom possesses is privileges. Privileges refer to the benefits and rights of a citizen. Every kingdom has its privileges. Now I want you to understand that it's a privilege. To be granted a right in a kingdom is a privilege. Being granted a right in a democracy is not a privilege.

Once you become a citizen, the government has to do some things for you. This is in a democracy. In America, you can burn the flag and use the law to protect you. In America, you can kill a child and use the law to protect yourself from a murder charge. Why? Because as a citizen, their laws grant you certain rights. But do you know that in the kingdom of God, every right you are given is a privilege? This means you are lucky. Is this a good word?

In other words, you do n't stand before God and say, "Listen, let me tell you something. Since you created me, you know, I..." No, no, don't come before God in that position. What? Yes. Yes. Yes. Let me tell you how I got rid of it? with what? By grace. It is better for you to remain silent and thank God for your salvation. Everything is done by grace. In the kingdom, the king grants you favor. It grants what they call favor in kingdoms. Let everyone say they have a special place. Favor. Let me tell you something.

Nothing is more powerful than the king's favor. Write this down. The king's favor becomes a personal law. What does the king's favor become? Personal law. This is too much for you today. I know that the Lord will help you to buy this tape so that you can listen to it again. This is extremely powerful. Last night I had to say to God, "Stop it." I sat in my home office at two o'clock and said, "Lord, stop it." I said, "Oh God, I can't teach this in my lifetime." They won't understand it. I will die.

"And they still won't understand it." Because you can see, it is so heavy and simple that we miss it because we are hungry, sleepy, and tired. I'll say this again. Listen to me first. Listen to him. God's favor, don't miss this, is a personal law. Now, you don't understand what I mean. Let me explain. The king has ceremonies. A decree is anything the king speaks and writes for the citizens to obey. But favor is a unique thing. The king can give you a personal law to live by. Ah, you didn't understand.

In other words, when the king grants you favor, it is not written in the books. This is something that will be decided to grant you personally as a privilege. Other citizens may not receive it. Ah, you don't understand. But for you, it becomes law. It works in your favor all the time. Hallelujah. Ah, that's very heavy, you know. If the Prime Minister of the Bahamas were to grant someone a personal favor, what would we call that? What do you call that from a political perspective? What do you call that?

Begging for favor. Begging. Begging for favor. If the Prime Minister denied you a personal favor, what would you call that? Persecution. Good. Therefore, neither the Prime Minister nor the President of any country can grant you a personal favor that violates the law. Anything he gives you must already be within the law. The king is different. You come to a king, and you know what? You deserve nothing. But the king has the power and authority to tell you: I can still give you this. You must praise Him.

And you know what else? No one can refute what he told you or take it away from you. Why? Because it has become your own private law. I will shout it myself. That's why God will bless you this week. Even though you don't deserve it, and even though others don't like it and can't stop it, today He decided to bless you. If you want to receive this kind of blessing, applaud him. Praise be to God. God's grace has nothing to do with what you do. Hallelujah. It is a special law.

Do you remember that young man who was a cupbearer working in the king's court? His name was Nehemiah. Just a worker. He was not a politician. He was not a secretary in the government. He was not a member of the cabinet. He was a servant, a slave in the court. But one day the king, may God have mercy on him, turned to him and said, " Why are you so depressed? You no longer serve me my drink with a smile." The young man said, "My country is in a sorry state. The walls are in ruins. My people are scattered.

I am depressed because my country is in such a sorry state." The king said, "Look at this. What do you want? Ladies and gentlemen, whatever you wish God would ask you just once, come forward, all of you. For as soon as the king speaks, he will issue a law just for you. Come forward, all of you. That is the difference. You see, the king makes laws with his words."

And despite the presence of famous leaders, powerful politicians, secretaries, and members of the royal court, this young slave received such favor that the king said to him, "Go and do as you please." I will give you messages. Man, that's a powerful blessing. I will give you a letter that will grant you permission to travel through all regions. You can get all the money you want, the trees you need for building, the nails and equipment from the king's warehouses.

Go to my cedar forest, and cut down all the wood you want. Why? If they ask you what you are doing, show them the letter. It's better for you to understand. Tell someone, I will receive a blessing this week and no one can stop me. Clap your hands and cheer for a moment. The king's blessing. Oh, hallelujah. I tell you, you think you should buy everything that belongs to you. Look, someone got away with it. I must buy it. God says, "No, all you have to do is speak the word."

God can speak to someone to give you what others have worked for for a thousand years. He can give it to you in one day. The king's favor is a personal law. It is a privilege to be under the rule of a king. Some of you are angry because people have been promoted above you because someone in power liked them more than you, and they are unqualified. You know, they're not fully prepared for that job, but because of some kind of relationship, they applied to you.

Well, I come to you in the name of another king to tell you that promotion does not come from the East, nor from the West, nor from the North, nor from the South, but this time promotion comes from the Lord. And whoever the Lord elevates, no man can lower his rank in the name of the king. God is the one who elevates. You have been bypassed, ignored, and your existence has been ignored for the past ten years. But I tell you, if you understand this message and raise your hands and say: "Lord, I am under your favor."

"God will challenge authority, confound the kings of the earth, and they will promote you without being able to explain why. They will give you more money without being able to explain how. You better thank God. This will happen in your lifetime. Oh, I know what I'm talking about. That's why God says it doesn't come from the East. It does n't come from people. In the world, you have to depend on people to promote you. But in God's kingdom, just go to your work on time. Work hard. Don't cheat your employer.

Don't steal his time. Don't steal his products. Be present. Why? Because when promotion comes from above, no one will be able to speak ill of your goodness. Promotion is coming. The kingdom has privileges. Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not his benefits. It is a benefit to be under the King's rule. The next very important thing in the kingdom is the code of ethics. And this is what we still struggle with. Every kingdom has a code of ethics.

This means it has a way of life where you live according to certain standards that you cannot violate. There are certain things that the King will not tolerate. And every kingdom has codes of ethics. And if I may say so, let me I'm coming to this part of the series. I'll be working on this for about three weeks because most of us don't realize how important this is. When you break the king's laws, you're actually giving up privileges and advantages.

The code of ethics means you live by certain standards in the kingdom. Certain things the king has set that you will never give up. That's why every kingdom has a list of what's allowed and what's forbidden. It's not to restrict you. It's to protect you. Lying, stealing, perjury, greed—these things we consider harsh—are laws. Jesus came to bring that. He came to bring a government. He came to bring a constitution. He came to restore privileges. He came to restore citizenship.

He claimed he would re-establish a way of life and a culture from heaven on earth. That's what he came to do. He didn't come to bring a religion. Let's read what he says here. Isaiah 9, verses 6 and 7, says, " For to us a child is born"—the past tense now—"to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulder." "He is coming with a government on his shoulders to present to mankind, and his name is called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

Verse 7 says: "Of the increase of his government and peace there will be no end." "He will reign. He will not be in a religion like any power, but he will come as King and he will reign. He will sit on David's throne and on his kingdom, establishing it, upholding it with justice and righteousness. From now until when? This means that once Christ comes and brings that government, it will be eternal. Hallelujah. Guess what? He has come. Which means the kingdom is here and it will not leave. Praise be to God.

It is not coming. It is here. I had a question the Holy Spirit asked me last night. And you can tell when the Lord is asking you a question because He keeps repeating it until you respond. He asked me a question last night. I had to write it down. It's a very simple question. The question was, if the kingdom is here, why aren't we taking advantage of it? I know God cannot lie and the kingdom is here according to Jesus. So the question is why aren't we taking advantage of it?

And He kept asking it until I got an answer. I got the answer. I'm going to tell you about it next week. So don't miss the session. Jesus is still talking about the kingdom. Look at this now. He is fulfilling his calling. Luke 4:42. But he said, and this is Jesus speaking, 'I must preach a kingdom.'" God is in other cities too. Why? Because that is the reason I was sent. Luke 17:20.

The Pharisees asked him when the kingdom of God would come, and he answered, “The kingdom of God does not come by careful observation, nor do people say, ‘Here it is,’ or ‘There it is.’” "For the kingdom of God is within you." He said that the kingdom is here. God's government is already present and it rules you from within. Oh, my God. Oh, I need two more lifetimes. Okay, let me try this pen. Look, God never created you to be controlled by a foreign government. This is a profound statement.

If the Kingdom of God had an effect in the Bahamas, no one would be in prison today. There will be no crime, no abuse, no corruption, no incest, and no sexual confusion. God never intended for you and I to be ruled from the outside. The less internal government you have, the more external government you will need. Please, understand this statement. Can I give you a glimpse into how God created nations? Let me explain that to you. God goes to Africa and chooses slaves who own nothing.

He takes them out and puts them in the desert. He says, "Okay, I'll start over. I'll create a nation out of you, the ones at the bottom. You own nothing. You are slaves. You have no identity. You have no credibility. You have no money. You own nothing." It starts with them. He says, "Now, first I'm going to give you a law." Ten Commandments. Then I will give you a constitution. With all the laws that I spoke from my mouth through Moses to give to you. He says: " Now I just want you to put my laws into your hearts.

Talk about them. Memorize them. Teach them to your children. Put them into your minds. Convince yourselves of them. Brainwash yourselves with my laws." But people did not cooperate with God. What did they say to God? They said, "O Moses, tell God, we want a king." What were they asking for? Foreign government. God's response was truly interesting. God said, " Moses, go back and tell the people, I will be their God. They will be my people, and that is all we need. Now, the problem is that God is invisible."

Ah, hallelujah. In other words, three million people living and moving around in the desert wanted a hidden government, ruling through their hearts. They love each other, they respect each other, they do not covet, they do not commit adultery, they do not lie, they do not steal, and no one knows why. Because their government is hidden. Imagine a people doing the right thing and no one knows why. This is what he wanted in your work every day. He wanted them to see you do the right thing and no one could say why.

I hid your words in my heart so that I would not sin against you. God never wanted you to put "I love Jesus" on your chest or " If you know Jesus" on your car. No stickers were found anywhere. He wanted them to see a lifestyle and culture that was very different from their own. They will say, "What makes you live like this? " And your answer will be, " My kingdom is not of this world." God says that you do not want a king. Moses went and told the people what God had said.

Moses says that the Lord God says that you do not want a king. He will be your king and you will be his people. So they sent Moses back to God. And so you say to God, look now. We want a king like other nations. They said, "Isn't this amazing?" We can see that their system is not working. Come on, guys. Talk to me. However, people still say, "Well, we want to go to the First World." What do we mean by that? Point the camera at me. Listen to me carefully. What do you mean by that? What is the First World?

Is it America? Do you want to inherit that garbage? Pornography, death, drugs, crime, divorce, murder. Is this the First World? You see, we still haven't learned the lesson. We still want a king like other nations. But I tell you, when I arrived, I'm a crazy man. You don't have to be with me. I am alone. But I believe in a way that the Bahamas will go through something where God will truly live here. Ah, I feel like screaming from the depths of my heart.

There will be a people in the world, in a small island nation, who truly live in holiness, cleanliness, and respect, and no one can see. Why? Because in that nation there is a hidden government. Ah, I will shout alone. I believe that there will be a kind of citizenship in some country where, when a politician asks you to do something wrong, you will say to him: " Sir, may your life be long, Your Excellency, but I cannot do that." Why? Because I am bound by an authority higher than you.

I will not compromise on my convictions. We need this type of person. Oh, we need students in school who will stand up in class and say, "Excuse me, teacher, I don't believe what you're saying, and I didn't come to school with my money to pay fees to listen to this nonsense you're teaching." Either you get expelled or I'll leave the class. Don't look at me with surprise. We need students who are subject to another government.

There are teachers who teach that the relationship between the two boys is acceptable in your school. It has reached our Bahamas. Last week I discovered that young girls are being raped by other girls in your school bathrooms, and the teachers are telling them that this is normal. Amen. Oh, we need students who are subject to another government, who say, "Look, we're going to protest." We will leave this chapter until the Prime Minister and the school principal rectify their situation.

We live according to a higher law, and in our country, God will dwell here in the name of Almighty Jesus. Sorry, I got carried away. We are talking about a people whose government was God, but they chose a human agency. God said to them, "If you choose this government, let me tell you what they will do." And God gave them a long list. God said: "First, they will take taxes from you." In Jamaica, every citizen must pay, listen carefully, 53% as a tax.

This means, my friend, that if you win $100, you only take $47 home. The rest goes to the Earth's government. This is what I call the venerable institutional slavery of California. To live in California. The tax is 43% of everything you earn, which goes to the state government. That's why you have to be a movie star to live there. Any other star will go out. This is not life. This is slavery. However, in my kingdom, let me stand here to talk about my kingdom.

My kingdom's government established a 10% quota 6000 years ago, and it still exists. I should cheer for myself. Our government will refund you 90%. This is more than enough to live on. They applauded him. Thank God. He is a good God. I say that he is a good God. I say that he is a good God. What I like about this god, this government, is that they take the ten percent. But he doesn't take it for himself. He doesn't put it where it is. Rather, he leaves it where you are. He uses it to train you to become better.

Oh, you don't understand. She still owns one hundred percent. We don't even know that we own one hundred percent. Long live the kingdom of God. I said, "Long live the Kingdom of God." Long live the kingdom of God. Long live the kingdom of God. Jesus was joking with them one day. They came to him and said, "Should we pay taxes to Caesar?" Jesus said, "Ah, good question. Let's talk about money." He said, "Okay, give me some of your local government's money." So they gave him some money.

And I know if you've noticed our money, it has pictures of people on it. The eye is on that money, the man is on that money. So that money does not belong to God. It belongs to that man. So Christ said, "Well, whose picture is this?" They said: "Caesar." He said: "That's right, that's correct." He said, " Now give Caesar what he asks for, because it is his property."
